description: Entrepreneurs utilize crowdfunding by using online platforms to raise money for their projects or businesses. They create campaigns on crowdfunding sites such as Kickstarter or Indiegogo to promote their ideas, share their stories, and collect pledges from investors. Crowdfunding campaigns are typically open-ended, meaning they may continue to raise funds until they reach their goal or their deadline.
